title: A Stranger Texted Me at 2:14 AM: Turn Off Your Porch Light #shorts #scarystories
description:
The texts knew things nobody should know.

Follow for new scary stories every day.

#scarystory #horrorstories #creepy #shorts

beats.text: At 2:14 in the morning, a stranger texted me. Turn off your porch light. Now.

overlay.message: Turn off your porch light. NOW.

beats.text: I live alone, in the last house on Willow Street.
Normally, I ignore wrong numbers.
But this time, I texted back.
The answer came in seconds.

overlay.message: No time. It follows the light.

beats.text: I pulled back the curtain.
My porch light was the only light on the whole street.
And something was standing right at the edge of it.
I slammed the switch off.
Another text.

overlay.message: Good. Go to the kitchen. Don't use the stairs.

beats.text: How did they know I had stairs?
I crept into the kitchen, in the dark.
Above me, something started coming down the stairs.
Slowly. One step at a time.
My phone lit up one last time.

overlay.message: Back door. Count to ten. Then run to the Millers'.

beats.text: I counted to ten, and my heart was pounding so loud I was sure it could hear.
Then I ran.
The Millers pulled me inside before I even knocked.
We watched my house from their window until sunrise.
In the morning, the police found nothing. No footprints. No broken locks.
Just every single light in my house, switched on.
That night, I finally looked up the number that saved me.
It wasn't unknown anymore.
Those texts were sent from my own phone. Tonight.
So now, every night at 2:14, I sit awake with my phone in my hand.
Because the night I forget to warn myself, is the night it gets in.
